title: NicholeZen (F4M)
description:
Enjoy my newest passion project, a daily listening morning ritual designed to get you in the correct headspace for an amazing, productive day. You’ll find these themes in the file:

Soft dominance, devotion and guidance Light teasing (I can’t get you too horny, that’s for later, after you’ve earned it) Good boys and good girls taking care of themselves for me Healthy habits: eating well, stretching, and staying hydrated (I may have my own personal reasons for this 💦) And of course, Yes Nichole Listen once each morning. Show up for me. Watch how good your days start to feel. Happy Nichole-Year! Love, Goddess
author: Goddess Nichole
